method: Existing catalogue, rejected candidates, original 200-candidate reconciliation, previous daily runs and git history reviewed before research. Each guide counts in exactly one primary interest. These are public-source desk guides, not EA Selected, on-site reviews, local validation, partnerships or EA bookings.

improvements: Within each geographic tier, a contrasting activity now outranks a same-field match sharing a collection and an interest.
Surprise browser regression derives the available pool size instead of assuming Tokyo always contains three guides.
New guides enter Compass, interest and destination pages, collections, dated releases, sitemap, Article/ImageObject data and Passport through existing publication contracts.

notes: Primary sources read in English, French, Dutch, Japanese and Korean-language context. Same-operator sources are not described as independent verification.

Every public source URL was re-requested. Royal Delft returns 403 to the plain research fetch but its official workshop page was readable through web browsing with a fresh same-day crawl. Its age, schedule, shipping and no-collection terms were checked there. No access control was bypassed.

Royal Delft's older tourism calendar is not used for current departures. Galimard's current French booking terms override older English prices. The Gardens' current ninety-minute walk overrides older City of Melbourne duration and prices.

Concertgebouw's next September performance is sold out, but future public lunchtime dates and ticket-release times are published. The guide describes the recurring system, not an available ticket for that date.
Kabukiza's September dates are not recycled as October availability. The evergreen single-act system has a short recheck window and requires the reader to use the current monthly notice.

photoReview.rightsBoundary: Official-source reuse rights remain explicitly not independently cleared under the existing EA editorial image policy. Attribution is not represented as a license. CC images retain their license links and change notices.
rejectedAlternatives: Lyon's extremely narrow macaron banner and tiny tour thumbnail. Selected a sharp real Jocteur counter from the market's own page, explicitly not a guaranteed tour stop.
Galimard's small Eze cologne thumbnail. Selected the actual creation studio image.
Melbourne's unrelated navigation image for another garden tour. Selected the city's programme-specific Heritage Walk image.
Oslo's uninformative close-up of splashing and a 12-pixel placeholder. Selected the full-sized shared-sauna deck photograph.
Delft's close-up of a plate was replaced with the wider participant workshop image, while the included item remains explicitly a tile.
Gelato ingredient photograph is described as ingredients, not an invented included tasting flight.

localVerification.visualReview: All eighteen new guide hero crops reviewed side by side at mobile and desktop widths. Home, Today, Compass, New and local planning inspected. Corrected two duplicate Wikimedia source labels before release.

responsiveAudit.interactions: Hero rotation, home suggestions, direct image credits, complementary local guides, save persistence, image links, comparison, search, city filters, mobile menu and Escape passed.
